meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会直接处理 Git 操作：拆分并生成原子提交、改写分支历史，以及回答某处改动由谁何时引入。动手前先读仓库状态，不擅自提交、推送或删除，结论会附上 commit hash 等命令证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码或调查 Git 历史（如 blame、bisect、reflog 等）时接管；普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把这些改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 会先看 diff 和最近提交的消息风格再分组

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁哪次提交改的
say.note: 用 blame 定位并给出 commit hash

say.text: 把这个分支的历史压缩整理一下
say.note: 改写前会确认分支和是否已推送

howto.what_en: Once installed, it makes Claude handle git work: staging atomic commits, rewriting or squashing branch history, and answering who/where/when a change came in. It reads repo state first, never commits, pushes or deletes unless asked, and cites commit hashes as evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs a commit or an investigation of git history, such as blame, bisect or reflog. Ordinary code edits are skipped.

say_en.text: Split these changes into a few atomic commits
say_en.note: It reads the diff and recent commit style first.

say_en.text: Find which commit changed this line
say_en.note: Uses blame and quotes the commit hash.

say_en.text: Squash and tidy this branch's history
say_en.note: Confirms branch and pushed status before rewriting.
